name: kaggle_tech
description: Multi-role benchmark: 166 unique résumés (962 rows with 796 exact/normalised duplicates removed) from the public Kaggle 'UpdatedResumeDataSet' (25 curator-assigned job categories), ranked against six real employer job postings. Relevance labels are the job categories assigned by the dataset's curators; no additional human relevance judgments were collected. Every job is ranked against the full pool of 166 résumés (996 job-résumé pairs per label scheme).

source.note: Cite the Kaggle dataset page in the paper; check its licence before redistributing the résumé texts.
